name: versailles-dbc
description: Deterministic test generation from Design-by-Contract specifications

scripts.prepublishOnly: bun run build && bun run smoke
scripts.example:generate: bun run build && (cd examples/order-service && node ../../bin/versailles extract-manifests && node ../../bin/versailles generate) && git diff --quiet -- examples || { echo 'ERROR: example:generate produced a diff under examples/ — regenerated output drifted from the committed workspace'; git diff --stat -- examples; exit 1; }
